dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about the Snegovik and Snegurochka...

dialogues.speaker: Oksana
dialogues.text: Hmmm... Are you concerned about the difference in terms of address? Well. Let me see how I should explain this...

dialogues.speaker: Oksana
dialogues.text: If I had to sum the situation up in a sentence... the female Snegoviks are also known as Snegurochka.

dialogues.speaker: Oksana
dialogues.text: "Snegovik" is the name of our race as a whole, while "Snegurochka"... is a name that human tales have given to our ladyfolk, which seems to have caught on for various reasons...
